summary: Retest of the preview ROOT redirect fix. Going to the root URL (/) now redirects to /simulator.html: title 'Factor Investment Simulator — Rolling Pro (Web)', heading visible, run-btn present, no 'Building something incredible' text. The app auto-ran: results-table and fullperiod-table each have 9 rows (8 indices + Custom Blend) with finite values. Equity, roll and dist charts are visible. Switching mode between SIP and Lumpsum and clicking Run works (SIP: 234 windows, Lumpsum: 2414 windows), with no NaN/Infinity. Opening /simulator.html directly also works. There were 0 console errors and 0 page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js redirects on the client after React mounts, so the root briefly shows the 'Opening…' fallback first. That is fine. A server-side redirect or a meta refresh in public/index.html would be faster but is optional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root / redirects to /simulator.html through window.location.replace in App.js. The static app is at frontend/public/simulator.html. Key testids: run-btn, input-mode (SIP/Lumpsum), results-table, fullperiod-table, status, equity-chart, roll-chart, dist-chart.
